seoTitle: Free String Similarity Comparer: Jaro-Winkler, Dice, Cosine
metaDescription: Compare two strings with Levenshtein, Jaro, Jaro-Winkler, Dice, Jaccard, cosine and LCS scores side by side. Free, runs locally.
intro: Scores two strings with ten common similarity measures at once so you can see how they differ.
why:
No single similarity score fits every job. Jaro-Winkler suits short names because it rewards a shared start. Dice and cosine on letter pairs suit longer text. Edit distance is easy to explain but harsh on long strings.

Paste two strings and see all scores from 0 to 1 side by side, each with a one-line description of what it measures. The Jaro-Winkler scores use the usual prefix length of 4 and scale of 0.1, and match the published values for MARTHA and MARHTA.
howTo: Choose whether to ignore case and collapse whitespace.
Compare the scores in the table.
Pick the measure that suits your data and set your own threshold.

faq.q: Which score should I use for names?
faq.a: Jaro-Winkler is a common choice for short names. Test it on your own data and set a threshold from examples.

faq.q: Why are bigram scores 0 for one-letter strings?
faq.a: A single character has no pairs of letters, so there is nothing to compare unless the strings are equal.

faq.q: Are the scores comparable to each other?
faq.a: Roughly, since all run from 0 to 1, but they measure different things. Compare scores of one measure across pairs.
